cohort: 14,112 women who gave birth between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2015.
finding: Several diagnoses including polyembryony, anemia, thrombocytopenia, preeclampsia, placenta previa, placenta implantation, uterine scarring, uterine rupture, retained placenta, stillbirth, and HELLP syndrome were significantly associated with perinatal transfusion and can be used to predict transfusion risk.
